_source: A real 'Zambian Language Form 1 Scheme of Work, Term 3' (a real Zambian secondary school's Languages Department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive. This is a genuine new subject for this app -- no Zambian Language content of any kind existed here before. Covers only the term this specific document addresses (Term 3) -- Term 1 and Term 2 are not included since no source document for them was available at the time this file was built, the same 'covers only what a real source actually supports' approach used for every other bundled subject in this app that started from a single-term document (e.g. this app's own Biology and Religious Education Form 1 files originally did, before later, fuller sources were found). The source cites the real official syllabus throughout -- '2024 Zambian Languages Syllabus, Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' -- with real page citations (pp.27-30). The source's own topic/sub-topic numbering (1.4.11 through 1.4.14, then 1.5.1) is reproduced exactly as printed, including the jump from Topic 1.4's own sub-topics straight to competency codes like '1.4.11.1.1' (four numbering levels deep) rather than a more typical three -- an irregularity in the source's own numbering, reproduced transparently rather than renumbered. The source's final three weeks (9-11) are a generic 'Revision' review of Listening and Speaking / Reading / Writing and Language Structure, naming no new specific competences of their own, so they are not encoded as topics here -- consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app. Its own Content/Concept, Learning Activities, Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

subject.name: Zambian Language
subject.description: Zambian Language syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

competencies.description: Construct indirect speech sentences, changing direct speech to indirect speech correctly
Use active and passive voice, distinguishing and transforming between the two
Use proverbs in context, identifying appropriate proverbs for given situations
Use form-level vocabulary correctly in sentences
Explain concepts used in translation, distinguishing source language from target language
Apply translation techniques (literal translation, substitution, borrowing) to translate texts
